notes.text: Muhammad was an Arab religious, military, and political leader, and the founder of Islam.
Muhammad is believed by Muslims to be the Seal of the Prophets, and along with the Quran, his teachings and normative examples form the basis for Islamic religious belief.
Muhammad is remembered as a religious figure connected with Saudi Arabia.
Muhammad's recorded life dates place this profile around 570-632.
Muhammad is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
